sentences.text: Court No. - 83 Case :- CRIMINAL REVISION No. - 3459 of 2014 Revisionist :- Anand Indauliya Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Revisionist :- Santosh Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt.Advocate Hon'ble Gautam Chowdhary,J.
Case called out in revised list.
No one is present on behalf of revisionist to press this revision.
However, learned A.G.A. for the State is present.

The matter is an old one pending since 2014, which has been filed against the order dated 08.10.2014 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, First, Agra in Case No. 348 of 2011 (F.I.
Vs. Anand Indauliya Kumar), under Section 7 read with Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, Police Station Achchhinera, District Agra, whereby discharge application filed revisonist has been rejected.
